title: Telegram
notStarted: You haven't added your Telegram yet.
intro: Your own Telegram bot. It answers only you, and only as you.
step1: Create your own bot: in Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot, follow the questions, and copy the token it gives you.
testFailed: Telegram did not accept this bot: {error}
step2: Link your own Telegram account, so your bot only answers you.
linkOpen: Open your bot in Telegram and press Start
linkHelp: On this phone or computer, tap the link above. Telegram opens your bot; press Start (or send the message it fills in). Then come back and press Check.
linkNotYet: Not yet: your bot has not received the Start message. Press Start in Telegram, then Check again.
linked: Linked to {who}. Your bot answers only this Telegram account.
loadFailed: Could not load your Telegram bot.
err_invalid_token: That doesn't look like a bot token. It has numbers, a colon, then letters, like 123456789:AA…
err_telegram_rejected: Telegram rejected this token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
err_install_bot: This is the shared Aquarium bot. Create your own bot with @BotFather.
err_bot_in_use: Someone else on this Aquarium already uses this bot. Create your own with @BotFather.
err_link_expired: The link expired. Press "Link my Telegram account" again.
err_telegram_account_in_use: That Telegram account is already linked to another person.
err_telegram_unreachable: Could not reach Telegram. Try again in a moment.
